newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fixes at highest since March 1980.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fixes at highest since March 1980.

text.p: Palladium, a rare white precious metal currently in critically short supply, was fixed at $240.00 per ounce on Friday, its highest price level since March, 1980.
Palladium is fixed twice daily in London and at its previous setting on Thursday afternoon, it was valued at $210.00.
The price of the metal has soared this year due to political and administrative problems preventing the world's major supplier, Russia, from exporting.
The cost of borrowing palladium has reached unprecedented levels of over 300 percent for a month, due to the scarcity of material.
A meeting of dealers in the metal and its sister metal platinum confirmed late on Thursday that although the market was critically tight, there were no companies in default.
A delegation of Russian exporters is in Tokyo discussing a belated start to exporting to their major Japanese customers possibly as soon as June 20.
